sql_fixes.why: SAFETY (brief AI section 3). The stored P1 notes send a leader to clip a bolt at a constriction and traverse to a bolted belay. Mountain Project, the only source for this route, still prints that pre-2013 description but adds that a 50 ft section of P1, with at least one of its bolts, collapsed in winter 2013. No source written after the collapse describes P1 (searched MP, the Index guide's lists, Abegg's Index page, web search for cascadeclimbers and other reports: nothing). So P1 notes now say only that the pitch partly collapsed in 2013 and its fixed gear cannot be counted on, in our own words. P1's pitch number, grade (5.9+) and crux flag are unchanged; P2-P4 are byte-identical to the live row. pitch_detail is a never-lock paragraph, so no ledger entry. Could also go through enrich:apply as a top-level pitch_detail with replace_pitch_detail: true.
